pages.title: Wanderers
text: Eight gentle creatures are not tied to one land. You will meet them across the March, in the open, in the caves and at the edge of lava.

Every gentle beast here can be brushed for its reagent once a minute, and is tempted and bred with that same reagent. It can be bonded like any gentle animal (see [familiars](familiars)), though none of them has a familiar gift of its own.
Several of their reagents grind into dye: see [reagents](reagents).

pages.title: On the open ground
text: - **Ash Hopper**: a small, quick hopper of the Steppe, the Crystal Fields and the Ember Wastes, in groups of two to four. **12 health**. Drops **1 to 2 Ash Tufts**.
- **Ridge Grazer**: a woolly grazer of the Highlands, the Glimmer Ridge and the Snow Fields. **26 health**, **2 armour**. Drops **1 to 2 Grazer Wool** (light grey dye).
- **Crag Bounder**: a horned grazer of the Highlands, the Glimmer Ridge, the Snow Fields and the Crystal Fields. **20 health**, **2 armour**. Drops **1 to 2 Bounder Horns**.

pages.title: In the air
text: - **Dust Flitter**: the commonest flier in the March, in every land including the Shallows. **8 health**. Drops **1 to 2 Flitter Wings**.
- **Glimmer Moth**: a small moth of the Crystal Fields, the Glimmer Ridge and the Reed Fen. **10 health**. Drops **1 to 2 Glimmer Dust** (cyan dye).

pages.title: Underground and by lava
text: - **Stone Grub**: a small, armoured grub of the dark caves under every land but the Shallows, two to five at a time. **10 health**, **4 armour**. Drops **1 to 2 Grub Husks** (brown dye).
- **Ember Drifter**: a floating ember that gathers by lava. **12 health**, **immune to fire**. Drops **1 to 2 Ember Motes** (red dye), an Ember reagent.

- **Magma Creeper**: a slow, armoured crawler of the hot stone by lava. **22 health**, **6 armour**, **immune to fire**. Drops **1 to 2 Magma Scales** (orange dye), an Ember reagent. Magma Scales call the Slag Titan at the Slag Throne.
Both lava dwellers turn up wherever the March has lava, in every land but the Shallows.
